title: Mizubaku Daibouken
overview:
Here and now, a young hippo rises up!

Mizubaku Daibouken is a side-scrolling platformer based on the Taito arcade game. The demon Fire Satan has kidnapped the animals of Woody Lake, including Tamasun, the girlfriend of the little hippo Hipopo, and Hipopo sets out across the land to rescue them. His weapon is the water bomb: throw it in an arc and it bursts into a stream that soaks and stuns enemies, so you can kick them away and send them rolling into others for chain bonuses. Water also puts out fires, makes plants grow into platforms and turns watermills and other machines. Hold the button to inflate a bigger bomb for a bigger flood, hunt for hidden rooms, and keep moving - take too long and an unbeatable reaper starts to chase you.

- 1 or 2 players
- Four difficulty levels and adjustable starting lives
- Memory backup save

今ここに一人の幼いカバが立ち上がる！
